name: The Sons of Velmorn
inspire: After a friendly fighter's successful Attack, Inspire the attacker and each friendly fighter that was adjacent to the target when the Attack roll was made.

reactions.name: Deadly Command
reactions.trigger: Use this immediately after your leader ({icon:leader}) uses a Core ability.
reactions.flavorText: The cursed crown King Velmorn wears grants him great control over his full-blooded sons.
reactions.rulesText:
Give that fighter a command token.

While your leader ({icon:leader}) has any command tokens, each time you make an Attack roll for a friendly Grave Guard ({icon:grave-guard}), your leader ({icon:leader}) is treated as being adjacent to the target.

reactions.name: Rise Again
reactions.trigger: You can use this ability in your Power step if your leader ({icon:leader}) is on the battlefield and they have no Charge tokens.
reactions.flavorText: Velmorn's heirs must fight eternally in his name.
reactions.rulesText: Remove 1 command token from them, then pick a slain friendly Grave Guard ({icon:grave-guard}). Raise that fighter and place them in a starting hex in friendly territory. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Raise Shields!
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after an enemy fighter's Attack if the target was a friendly bulwark ({icon:bulwark}) and the Save roll contained any {icon:crit}.
abilities.flavorText: Velmorn's people were famed for their drill and the strength of their shieldwalls. Little has changed.
abilities.rulesText: Give that friendly fighter a Guard token.

abilities.name: The Velmorn Curse
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly fighter is slain by an attacker adjacent to them.
abilities.flavorText: Woe betide those who would harm the House of Velmorn, for a dread curse clings to their ancient bones...
abilities.rulesText: Inflict 1 damage on the attacker. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Surprise Swiftness
abilities.trigger: Use this in a Power step.
abilities.flavorText: Though their bodies are but mouldering bones, the power of the Tyrant's Crown - and their own revenant grief - grants Velmorn's line the occasional burst of swiftness.
abilities.rulesText: Friendly fighters have +2 Move in the next turn. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Five deathrattle skeletons who advance slowly at Move 3, led by King Morlak and his hardy son Jedran, backed by three fragile two-wound Grave Guard. Inspiring comes from ganging up, so every fighter adjacent to a successfully attacked enemy is upgraded, and Deadly Command lets the leader count as adjacent to Grave Guard targets. Shielded bulwarks earn Guard tokens from critical saves, a one-shot raise returns a fallen guard, and the warband wins by holding a tight shieldwall and grinding foes down together.
